plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed internally, not launched: deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy tips`, /opt/openvibe.tips, unit openvibe-tips, 127.0.0.1:4610 loopback only; https://openvibe.tips still serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder. Principal tips; Events subscriptions billing.transaction.* and billing.receipt.* -> /internal/events (secret rotated 2026-09-24); TIPS_CHAT_ADAPTER is empty (no chat side effects); TIPS_CHAT_ADAPTER=chat delivers through OpenVibe.Chat's ingress once tips is granted chat.message.send, chat.event.publish and identity.subject.resolve.
database: PostgreSQL 18 through PgBouncer (transaction mode) as the system of record, Valkey 9 for shared state (per-actor limits, overlay fan-out, overlay stream slots), ADR-035: database ov_tips from OpenVibe.Host's data role, schema in migrations/ (0001_initial expand, 0002_drop_legacy_import contract), async on openvibe-sdk/db v0.28.0, money paths serializable with row locks, PostgreSQL outbox and inbox.
notes: Runtime, API, SSR pages, overlays, the Billing settlement consumer and the events outbox are built, tested and deployed, together with /metrics (loopback only), truthful /api/ready (Billing and Events checks), supporter privacy (anonymous, hidden amount, private message), goal and supporter-page settings, export and erasure (tips.interaction.erased), moderation (word filter, hide/show, invited moderators, tips.interaction.moderated) and per-actor limits. Capabilities (18 tips.*) and payload schemas are in openvibe-contracts. No billing.* event had arrived: Billing runs in shadow. A written internal threat review (docs/threat-review.md) with its fixes and test/security.test.js. Not done: an independent security review; the openvibe.tips launch. Live stays the place tips happen until the Billing cutover (blocked on the owner re-pointing the PowerChat webhook) and the launch rule in README.md holds.
features: tips, paid messages, TTS and media requests settled by OpenVibe.Billing (never Tips' own money)
goals counted from settled payments only
overlays with revocable scoped tokens and replay without recharging
moderation: word filter, hide and show, invited moderators
server-rendered creator pages useful without JavaScript
PostgreSQL + Valkey data tier (ADR-035): serializable money paths, leased background work, shared limits and overlay fan-out
SDK outbox and inbox on PostgreSQL
Billing client on openvibe-sdk/commerce (shared with VIP): same capabilities, idempotency keys and retry rule
